text: Figure 3.16: Allocate Safety Measure Task Definition Allocate Safety Measure Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Library::Common Elements::Safety::T asks Brief Description Allocate Safety Measure to AUTOSAR elements. Description Safety measures which are safety mechanisms realized in AUTOSAR are allocated to AUTOSAR elements in order to describe what elements are involved in the provision of a safety measure. This task adds the corresponding "ALLOCA TION" reference. The reference can be contained by the AUTOSAR element or by the safety measure. The allocation can be done on different levels, depending on the granularity of the safety measures and the availability of the appropriate elements in the model. Relation Type Related Element Mult.
